account_specific_request_quota.detail: Historical documentation recorded 1000 requests/5 minutes; current account quota not verified.

cache_provenance.detail: Approval, membership, implementation and endpoint configuration bound; response hashes, atomic cache and durable journal. Live provider content remains unverified.

historical_backfill_completeness.detail: No reliable provider completion indicator; every successful history remains completion UNVERIFIED, including empty arrays.

historical_timestamp_semantics.detail: Change-oriented observations after requested since; initialized boundary records/backfill do not prove contemporary availability, continuity or duration.

history_response_structure.detail: Local arrays: aware timestamp, shop.id/name, deal or null; preserve raw order, duplicate timestamps and ambiguity.

lookup_response_structure.detail: Saved pilot objects: found boolean, matched game.id UUID; provider current behavior not live-verified.

matching_rules.detail: Lookup by Steam AppID; no title fallback; preserve found=false separately. Provider mapping accuracy is UNKNOWN.

pagination_support.detail: Existing implementation has no pagination. Unexpected Link/cursor/object wrapper stops; one array request is an assumption.

rate_limit_headers.detail: Retry-After/Date handled; reliable remaining/reset headers unknown.

response_size_limits.detail: Provider limit unknown; collector safety cap 8 MiB is local policy, not a provider quota or complete truncation detector.

retry_behavior.detail: Mock tests: <=3 attempts total per game/endpoint across restart; 408/transient 5xx/timeouts; bounded Retry-After; global 60-request cap.

timeout_behavior.detail: 30-second urllib socket timeout, not a guaranteed whole-response wall-clock deadline.

determinism.environment_note: Credential presence is environment-specific; identical in both runs. Live ciphertext intentionally uses fresh randomness; no live cache is generated in preparation.

unverified: Adversarial operator blindness; procedural trust required
